'''Joey Dial''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Virginia Beach tournament]] on 8 July 2001 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|MWYHL]], according to Mark Carila's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2597">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-08-virginia-beach-va-7-8-01-yavin-ivd2597/ virginia-beach-va-7-8-01-yavin-iv], DeckTech (Mark "MASSACRE" Carila, 8 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-08-virginia-beach-va-7-8-01-yavin-ivd2597/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
